name: comment-cut
description: Cut comment bloat out of a branch without losing the comments that matter. Sweeps the mechanical classes, then judges area by area against four narrow keep-rules, each with a test that is hard to invoke loosely: a silent-failure guard, a measured constant at the constant, an external-world workaround, and JSDoc on a contract consumed outside its module. The default action is delete, not tighten, because tightening converts deletes into rewrites. Verification is the point: a comments-only change is proven by comparing esbuild minified output, so a stray string-literal or logic edit cannot pass, and an invariant-signal scan over every removed line catches the over-cut that typechecks and tests cannot see. Reads its keep/cut bar from the target repo, never from a copy baked into the plugin.
